Open items for the lab (technical):

1) Keys & network
- Ops team: please create a scoped service account key and send it to our secure upload link (Ill DM the link to Emily). We only need token-level access, no DB access.

2) Dataset & prompts
- Novus: please provide the 10–20 prompt set in a CSV with columns: id, prompt_text, expected_snippet. If you have replay traces, a subset is helpful but not required.

3) Target load plan (we propose):
- Warmup: 50 qps for 5 min
- Burst A: 200 qps for 5 min
- Burst B: 500 qps for 3 min (only if youre comfortable)

4) Environment notes
- We will run the targeted surge against a Dedicated-equivalent pool (no customer-side infra changes). Please confirm any IP allowlists needed.

Ill prep a short runbook and attach it to the invite. Ben, can you confirm who should own the recording and notes? Grace, will you take point on quality checks (expected_snippet matching)?

—Dev
